SELECT * from (SELECT DISTINCT rel.industry_view_id AS screenId, rel.industry_view_type AS screenType, rel.view_name AS screenName, sdcc.id AS id, IFNULL(sdcc.is_customize,'0') AS isCustomize, sdcc.camera_num AS cameraNum, sdcc.iot_num AS iotNum, sdcc.radar_num AS radarNum, sdcc.speaker_num AS speakerNum, sdcc.uav_num AS uavNum, sdcc.recorder_num AS recorderNum, sdcc.grid_num AS gridNum, sdcc.grid_keeper_num AS gridKeeperNum, sdcc.resources_num AS resourcesNum, sdcc.alarm_type_num AS alarmTypeNum, IFNULL(sdcc.update_by,'') AS updateBy, sdcc.update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_industry_view_rel rel LEFT JOIN vm_screen_data_config_count sdcc ON rel.industry_view_id = sdcc.screen_id and rel.industry_view_type = sdcc.screen_type and sdcc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and sdcc.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND sdcc.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} WHERE rel.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND rel.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode}

AND sdcc.update_by LIKE CONCAT('%', #{updateBy}, '%')
AND DATE_FORMAT(sdcc.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{updateTimeStart}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(sdcc.update_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{updateTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')

mapper.update: update vm_screen_data_config set delete_flag = 1 where delete_flag = 0 and screen_data_config_id = #{screenDataConfigId}
mapper.insert: insert into vm_screen_data_config_count ( screen_id, screen_type, is_customize, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, delete_flag, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code) values (#{screenId}, #{screenType}, #{isCustomize}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now(), 0, #{tenantId}, #{industryCode}, #{appVerCode})

insert into vm_screen_data_config ( screen_data_config_id, data_type, data_source, data_code, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, delete_flag ) values
(#{item.screenDataConfigId}, #{item.dataType}, #{item.dataSource}, #{item.dataCode}, #{item.createBy}, now(), #{item.updateBy}, now(), '0' )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT data_code AS code, data_type AS dataType, data_source AS source FROM vm_screen_data_config WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND screen_data_config_id = #{screenDataConfigId}
